purpose: Generated promotional concepts, pending visual review. Not uploaded to App Store Connect.
prompts:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a beautiful finished promotional screenshot for Pluck, a tiny macOS utility that copies text from a selected area of the screen using OCR. This is concept artwork demonstrating a real capability, not a fabricated screenshot of Pluck's interface.
Format: landscape 16:10, ideally 2560 x 1600. Full-bleed polished graphic design, no monitor or phone mockup.
Art direction: warm minimal editorial design. Flat warm ivory background #f7f6f2, very dark forest green typography #253b30, restrained cobalt blue #335be5 only for selection and movement. Real photographic subject, tactile materials, sunlight and subtle physical shadows. Premium independent Mac utility aesthetic, deliberately composed, calm and highly legible.
The user's criticism of the old art: the source looked like text in an editor, and the app window got too much attention. Fix that completely. The image must unmistakably be a PHOTO or VIDEO IMAGE of physical words, not typed text on a white UI card. Do not show any Pluck app window, settings screen, browser chrome or dashboard.
Layout: small understated Pluck wordmark top left; big confident headline in the top quarter, then the main visual fills most of the lower area. Left: generous photo with visibly physical text, selected by a thin cobalt rectangle and small crosshair. Right: smaller clean editable-text result on an unadorned ivory-white sheet, simple black type, a subtle insertion caret and one tiny label "Copied text". A graceful cobalt connector arrow makes source-to-text unmistakable. All extraction examples must match EXACTLY between photographed source and plain text output. This is extraction, not summarization or rewriting.
Typography: beautiful legible sans-serif headline, balanced typography, generous breathing space. Every word should be readable at thumbnail scale. No badges, feature grids, fake menus, fake buttons, icons scattered everywhere, gradients or generic tech decoration. No rounded app window chrome. Output only the final artwork.
Asset 1 of a coordinated set. Exact headline: "Copy the uncopyable." Exact supporting line beneath it: "Select words on screen. Paste them anywhere."
Main source photograph: an outdoor flower-market entrance on a sunlit street, close enough that a physical dark green A-frame painted sign is the dominant subject, with real wood edges, angled perspective, fresh flower buckets and pavement visible. The sign has exactly three extremely readable lines of large cream paint: "SUNDAY" / "FLOWER MARKET" / "9 AM – 2 PM". Make it unmistakably a camera photograph of a real physical sign, no text-editor appearance. The blue selection box surrounds those three lines. The output sheet reproduces exactly those three lines as ordinary editable text. At the bottom use the understated text "⌘ ⇧ 2  →  select  →  paste", with command and shift glyphs visually balanced, all with ample margin.

Asset 2 of a coordinated set. Exact headline: "Copy from a paused video." Exact supporting line: "Keep the words. Skip the retyping."
Main source photograph: a beautiful paused educational film image, showing the cropped torso of a person in neutral clothing at the far left beside a large real dark green chalkboard in a sunlit creative studio. The chalkboard contains exactly two clear lines of white hand-lettered chalk text: "Make space" / "for better ideas." Chalk has convincing powdery texture. A tiny simple video play triangle and a thin playback progress line along the photograph's bottom edge establish that this is a paused video; these are subtle and are not the focal point. No recognizable real person or brand. Cobalt selection around the chalk words. To the right, the output sheet reproduces exactly "Make space" / "for better ideas." in plain editable black type with a small insertion caret.
